Guidance

Fulfilment House Due Diligence Scheme registered businesses list

Check if the business that stores your goods in the UK is registered with the Fulfilment House Due Diligence Scheme if you’re a trader based outside of the UK.

From:
HM Revenue & Customs
Published:
17 April 2019
Last updated:
11 August 2026 — See all updates

Details

Use this list if you’re a trader that is not established in the UK, to check if the business that stores your goods in the UK is registered with the Fulfilment House Due Diligence Scheme.

Contact VAT enquiries or email notificationofnoncompliance.fulfilmenthouse@hmrc.gov.uk if you have any questions about the scheme.
